$comment: What FRIDAY can read and make, by kind of file. 'built' has a tool and a test; 'needs-tool' also needs an installed program; 'partial' says in 'note' what is missing; 'not-built' is the honest gap. The brain answers 'can you read or make X' from this file and from the tools that are really installed.

read.note: any language; the code map covers the languages in kernel/code_languages.json

make.note: fs.make writes html, md, txt, csv and json from a description; fs.write writes any text or code

run.note: after the owner's approval, in the sandbox where one is set up

read.note: docx, odt, rtf and epub are read as text (odt, rtf and epub readers were added with their writers); old binary .doc is not read

make.note: docx, odt, rtf and epub are made from a description and read back here; rtf, odt and epub keep Hindi and every other character; opening them in Word or LibreOffice was not checked
xlsx and csv from rows; text is stored as text and no formula is written; opening it in Excel was not checked
pptx with a title and bullets per slide; no pictures or charts; opening it in PowerPoint was not checked

read.note: text with PyMuPDF; a scanned page is read with OCR when it is installed

make.note: text pages in Latin letters only; other scripts such as Hindi become '?' and the result says so; use docx or html for those

read.note: unsafe names and bombs are refused; rar is read only

make.note: zip, tar, tar.gz, tar.bz2, tar.xz; 7z and rar are not made

read.note: size and type always; the words in a picture with OCR; what is in it needs a vision-capable model

make.tool: image generation with a connected cloud provider
make.note: needs a connected provider and the billing and privacy gates; no local image model yet; svg can be written as text

read.note: faster-whisper on this PC reads a file through media.transcribe; media.probe needs ffmpeg

make.note: she speaks aloud and media.convert makes audio files from audio or video with ffmpeg; saving a spoken reply to a file and making music are not built

read.note: watched in steps, not live: length and streams with ffmpeg, up to 12 evenly spaced still pictures a vision model can look at, and what was said as text from the sound track; the pictures and the words are put together by the model, there is no single sound-and-picture model

make.note: convert, cut, extract audio or a frame, and join pictures into a slideshow with ffmpeg; generating new video from a prompt is not built

read.note: SQLite files: list tables and run one read-only SELECT (limited rows, a time limit, nothing can change the file); Windows programs and other databases are identified from their headers only and never executed; a notebook reads as json

make.note: no database or program is made from a description
